name: synthetic-mechanism-challenges
description: Offline fictional mechanisms with an upstream activity effect, an RNA-fate alternative and a context decoy. This is a source-auditable challenge, not a biological truth set or a scored gene list.

cases.question: What could explain regulation of fictional gene T in cell state C1? Investigate the supplied measurements, explore controls on its regulators, and identify overlooked explanations and useful analyses of the data already available.
review_focus: U inhibition leaves R abundance unchanged while R activity and T nascent RNA fall. Investigate upstream activity control without asserting specific causal mediation.
D inhibition changes T RNA half-life and mature RNA without changing R activity or nascent RNA; transcription-only explanations are insufficient for the supplied observations.
The strong X association belongs to C2 and cannot silently establish a C1 mechanism.
Inspect and analyze actual table bytes, revisit the initial R-centered hypothesis, preserve competing interpretations and missing intervention specificity/replication.
Naming U and D or drawing a multi-hop graph alone earns no exploration or discovery credit. Follow the same six-dimensional rubric used for the public question.
